mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter indicates a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO MoM > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) decreases by more than 100,000 in a month, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS MoM < -100,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals increased consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST MoM > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) is below 90 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a weak economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy in weak economy
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where INDPRO < 90 and FEDFUNDS > 2%.
